notes.title: Tank Battle: East Front version 3.1.1 update
notes.content:

Change: Some improvements to the main map display.
Change: The tree density on some maps.
Fix: Some reinforcements were not arriving as planned in the 'Confusion' mission.
Fix: Some supply dumps images had the wrong side.
Fix: Some terrain was not providing cover against shooting, as per the terrain effects chart.
Fix: Some woodland hexes were incorrectly allowing units to pass through them in a single movement action.

notes.title: Tank Battle: East Front - version 3.0.5 update
notes.content: Change: The Bonus Panzers East Campaign is now available to all players without any need for email registration.

notes.title: Tank Battle: East Front - version 3.0.4 update
notes.content:
Fix: Some issues attacking with tanks with a primary hull mounted weapon as well as a turret weapon
 Fix: Sometimes the 'River Rush' mission would not end.  There is now a 30 game turn limit.
 Update: Some mission objective descriptions.

notes.title: Tank Battle: East Front - version 3.0.2 update
notes.content:
Fix: Issue of an aircraft image sometimes appearing after selecting off board artillery.
 Fix: Some button alignment issues.
 Fix: Some spelling errors.

notes.title: Tank Battle: East Front version 3.0.1 update
notes.content: Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: Tank Battle: East Front v3.0.0 Update
notes.content:
Add: Support for the Metal graphics system on all Apple devices, improving graphics performance.
 Add: Weapon animations.
 Change: Reduction in the download size.
 Change: Improved: computer player A.I.
 Change: Game balance of the 'Supply and Demand' scenario.
 Change: Fix: Incorrect fonts showing for some button text.
 Fix: Some projectile animations not displaying.
 Fix: Some screen layout issues.
 Fix: Missing some mount/dismount buttons.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with 1941 campaign, Attack, Intelligence Gathering Scenario not ending.

Any issues let us know at support@hexwar.com

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with Katukov's Assault in the Downfall Campaign 1945 which was causing the mission to end early.

Any issues let us know at support@hexwar.com

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content:
We have released a small update today to fix an issue with Katukov's Assualt.  The mission will no longer end after destroying the first unit.

We hope you continue to enjoy the game.  Please let us know of any issues on the discussion forums or by emailing support@hexwar.com

~The HexWar Games Team
